editorNote: A quiet day with no single large release. OpenAI published a report on disrupting AI-enabled influence operations, and Anthropic tightened its usage policy against abuse and election interference. On the product side, Google is pushing a Gemini agent for workplace tasks, and Claude Haiku 5.5 is drawing attention for price against a rival small model, though that comparison is secondhand.
